items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I demonstrated the Theremin to Madame Schumann-Heinck.

ctx.x: There were several outstanding orchestras around besides you, is there?

Oh, yes. Yes, sir. Sure. Why? Well, any place you go in New Orleans, you had a good band. But it looked like we played, the Owls or Brownlee's band would play for so many of the fraternities and sororities of Tulane. And then Loyola, of course, came into the picture after. And we played quite a bit up at Loyola Gym. We played up there very often. And I remember Cupera. You know, part of my work with Wuerline was organizing school bands. And that was my job was the Con Factory too, you see. For years I organized…
